cases.sentence: Саул повелел своему сыну Иоаннафану и всем слугам убить ___, но Иоаннафан был очень привязан к нему.
cases.translation: Saul ordered his son Jonathan and all his servants to kill David, but Jonathan was very attached to David.
cases.explain: The transitive verb убить (to kill) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Завтра утром берегись, спрячься в укрытии и оставайся там, я выйду в поле и встану рядом с ___.
cases.translation: Tomorrow morning be careful; hide yourself and remain there. I will go out into the field and stand with my father.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Пусть царь не грешит против своего слуги ___ потому что Давид не согрешил против тебя.
cases.translation: Let the king not sin against his servant David, because David has not sinned against you.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Саул послушался Иоаннафана и дал ___. Верно, как и то, что жив Господь, Давид не будет предан смерти.
cases.translation: Saul listened to Jonathan and swore an oath: As the Lord lives, David will not be put to death.
cases.explain: The transitive verb дал (gave) requires the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Давид вышел сражаться с филистимлянами и нанес им такое поражение от ___, что они бежали.
cases.translation: David went out to fight the Philistines and defeated them so thoroughly that they fled.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governing the source of action requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Саул посылал людей в дом Давида, чтобы следить за ним и убить его с ___.
cases.translation: Saul sent messengers to David's house to watch him and kill him in the morning.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) with morning requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Михаль спустила Давида через окно, и он убежал из ___.
cases.translation: Michal let David down through the window, and he fled and escaped.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from/out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Давид пришел к Самуилу и рассказал ему о враждебных действиях ___ против себя.
cases.translation: David came to Samuel and told him about Saul's hostile actions against him.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Иоаннафан был очень привязан к Давиду и предупредил его. Мой отец Саул ищет возможности убить тебя.
reading.question: What did Jonathan do when he learned Saul wanted to kill David?
options: He warned David that Saul was seeking to kill him
He told Saul to forgive David
reading.correct: He warned David that Saul was seeking to kill him
reading.explain: Jonathan was attached to David and warned him that his father Saul was trying to kill him.

reading.ru: Иоаннафан говорил своему отцу Саулу о Давиде только хорошее и сказал ему. «Пусть царь не грешит против своего слуги Давида, потому что Давид не согрешил против тебя, и потому что своими делами он сослужил тебе большую службу».
reading.question: What did Jonathan say to defend David before Saul?
options: That David had not sinned against Saul and had served him well
That Saul should apologize to David
reading.correct: That David had not sinned against Saul and had served him well
reading.explain: Jonathan defended David by saying he had not sinned and had done great service to Saul.

reading.ru: В ту ночь Давид убежал и спасся. Саул послал людей в дом Давида, чтобы выследить и убить его утром, но Михаль, жена Давида, предупредила его.
reading.question: Who helped David escape from Saul's men that night?
reading.explain: Michal, David's wife, warned David and helped him escape from Saul's messengers.

reading.ru: Михаль взяла истукан, положила его на кровать, накрыла ему голову покрывалом из козьей шерсти и закутала его одеждой.
reading.question: What did Michal do to deceive Saul's messengers?
options: She placed an idol in the bed with a pillow at its head and covered it with clothes
She hid David in a closet
She told them David was already gone
reading.correct: She placed an idol in the bed with a pillow at its head and covered it with clothes
reading.explain: Michal put an idol in the bed with a goat's hair pillow and covered it with clothes to make it look like David.

reading.ru: Саул сказал Михаль, «Зачем ты обманула меня и отпустила моего врага, чтобы он спасся?»
reading.question: How did Saul respond when he discovered the deception?
options: He confronted Michal about deceiving him and letting his enemy escape
He thanked her for helping David
reading.correct: He confronted Michal about deceiving him and letting his enemy escape
reading.explain: Saul accused Michal of deceiving him and letting David escape.

reading.ru: Когда они увидели группу пророков, которые пророчествовали, и Самуила, который возглавлял их, Дух Божий сошел на людей Саула, и они также стали пророчествовать.
reading.question: What happened when Saul's messengers saw the prophets and Samuel?
options: God's Spirit came upon them and they also began to prophesy
reading.correct: God's Spirit came upon them and they also began to prophesy
reading.explain: When Saul's messengers saw the company of prophets and Samuel, God's Spirit came on them and they prophesied.
